package tech

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// GetTechByLabel fetches tech by label.
type GetTechByLabel struct {
	Techs repository.TechRepository
}

// Handle returns tech by label.
func (uc GetTechByLabel) Handle(ctx context.Context, label string) (*domain.Tech, error) {
	tech, err := uc.Techs.GetByLabel(ctx, label)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return tech, nil
}
